name: Convex Notify
summary: A Convex template for robot requests that notify recipients, await approval, and trigger backend dispatch.
description: An editable request-and-approval template for a shared Convex deployment. A sender creates a pending robot request for another VoiceOS user; the recipient reviews it and approves or declines. Your Convex respond mutation should atomically validate the recipient and request status, store the decision, and trigger robot dispatch only on approval.

preferences.name: CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT_URL
preferences.title: Deployment URL
preferences.description: Convex Dashboard -> Deployment Settings. Copy the deployment URL ending in .convex.cloud.

preferences.name: VOICEOS_USER_ID
preferences.title: VoiceOS user ID
preferences.description: Enter the stable user ID your Convex schema uses for the current VoiceOS user.

preferences.name: CONVEX_ACCESS_KEY
preferences.title: Access key
preferences.description: Optional. Convex Dashboard -> Deployment Settings -> API Keys / Deploy Keys; leave blank when your functions use another public authentication flow.

preferences.name: CONVEX_LIST_REQUESTS_PATH
preferences.title: List requests path
preferences.description: Set this to your public query's module and export name.

preferences.name: CONVEX_GET_REQUEST_PATH
preferences.title: Get request path
preferences.description: Set this to your single-request query's module and export name.

preferences.name: CONVEX_CREATE_REQUEST_PATH
preferences.title: Create request path
preferences.description: Set this to the mutation that creates a pending robot request.

preferences.name: CONVEX_RESPOND_REQUEST_PATH
preferences.title: Respond request path
preferences.description: Set this to the mutation that records approval or decline and dispatches only after valid approval.

tools.name: list_robot_requests
tools.title: List robot requests
tools.description: List incoming or outgoing robot requests in Convex. Use when the user asks what robot visits are waiting for approval, what they requested, or the status of recent robot requests.

direction.description: Incoming requests for this user or outgoing requests sent by this user; default incoming

limit.description: Maximum requests to fetch; the card displays up to four

tools.name: get_robot_request
tools.title: Get robot request
tools.description: Fetch one robot request by its Convex document ID. Use when the user asks for the details of a specific request or before asking them to approve or decline it.

tools.name: request_robot
tools.title: Request robot
tools.description: Create a pending Convex request asking another VoiceOS user to approve a robot visit to their table. Use when the user asks to send or bring a robot to a recipient; approval and physical dispatch happen later through the recipient's response and backend automation.

recipientId.description: Exact VoiceOS ID of the person who must approve

tableLabel.description: Human-readable destination table, such as Table 12

robotLabel.description: Robot name or identifier; defaults to Robot

note.description: Optional reason or message shown to the recipient

tools.name: respond_robot_request
tools.title: Respond to robot request
tools.description: Approve or decline a pending robot request addressed to the current VoiceOS user. Use only after fetching the request details; approving writes the decision to Convex so the user's backend can dispatch the robot atomically.

tableLabel.description: Fetched destination shown for verification; backend should verify it against the request

robotLabel.description: Fetched robot shown for verification; backend should verify it against the request

requesterId.description: Fetched requester shown for verification; backend should verify it against the request

responseNote.description: Optional response to store with the decision
